# Phase 4 — Distribution

[GENESIS §14 Phase 4](GENESIS.md). Wires up `dist` (formerly cargo-dist),
release workflow, Homebrew tap / Scoop bucket / winget manifests, code
signing + macOS notarization, `maru update` self-update, and mdBook
docs site.

Exit criterion: `brew install <tap>/maru`, `scoop install maru`,
`winget install maru`, `curl -sSL ... | sh` all work on a fresh machine.

This phase has external dependencies the bot can't satisfy alone:
publishing to Homebrew / Scoop / winget requires separate repositories
or PRs, and macOS notarization + Windows code signing require certs
the user holds. We scaffold the in-repo pieces and document the manual
steps in `docs/notes/phase-4-handoff.md`.

## Tasks

- [x] **4.1** — `dist-workspace.toml` configured for x86_64+aarch64 linux-gnu, x86_64+aarch64 darwin, x86_64 windows-msvc. Pinned to dist 0.31.0. Includes shell + powershell + homebrew installers.
- [x] **4.2** — `.github/workflows/release.yml`: tag-triggered build matrix + plan-only dry-runs on PRs + publish job. Hand-crafted (will be `dist generate`-d on first `dist init` run by the user).
- [~] **4.3** — Homebrew tap config in dist-workspace.toml (`tap = "itsgg/homebrew-maru"`). **User-blocked**: create the empty repo + add `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` secret. See `docs/notes/phase-4-handoff.md`.
- [~] **4.4** — Scoop bucket: not enabled in dist 0.31.0; user submits manifest PR per release. Tracked in handoff.
- [~] **4.5** — winget: not auto-submitted by dist 0.31.0. Use `wingetcreate update --submit` per release. Tracked in handoff.
- [~] **4.6** — macOS notarization + Windows code signing: secret slots reserved in `release.yml`; **user-blocked** on cert provisioning. Releases without these slots ship unsigned.
- [~] **4.7** — `maru update` self-update: **deferred** to v0.2. dist's installer scripts handle update via re-running the curl one-liner; a native `maru update` subcommand is more work than fits Phase 4 scope.
- [x] **4.8** — mdBook scaffolding at `docs/book/{book.toml,src/{SUMMARY.md,introduction.md,...symlinks}}`. `docs.yml` workflow builds + publishes to GitHub Pages on push to main.
- [x] **4.9** — README updated with brew/scoop/winget/curl one-liners (labeled "after first release" until v0.1.0 ships).
- [x] **4.10** — `docs/notes/dist-exit-plan.md` documents the `softprops/action-gh-release` matrix fallback if axodotdev/dist becomes unmaintained.
